name: discord-patched-electron
description: Build and package Discord's native Electron integration

scripts.lint: bun run lint:source && bun run lint:rust
scripts.lint:source: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && oxlint integration tests && oxfmt --check . && uv run python scripts/check_style.py && uv run actionlint
scripts.format: uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format . && oxfmt --write . && uv run python scripts/check_style.py --fix && cargo fmt --all
scripts.test:python: uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
